custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · Schedule access · about 45 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • At least 8 eligible technicians at this location (as in the scroll test), [Tech-A] to [Tech-H]. A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Top Left" (used by this case only) with about 20 Approved work orders led by one technician, [Tech-A], so the board and table scroll both ways.
  • Names are examples; what must hold: the board and the Tech View table both scroll right and down.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Create everything below in this location.
  3. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard), [Tech-B] (e.g. Ralph Edwards), [Tech-C] (e.g. Jenny Wilson), [Tech-D] (e.g. Theresa Webb), [Tech-E] (e.g. Kristin Watson), [Tech-F] (e.g. Brenda Martinez), [Tech-G] (e.g. Cameron Williamson), [Tech-H] (e.g. Floyd Miles).
  4. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Top Left" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  5. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Top Left": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Assign lead technician (an older screen shows Reassign lead technician) > click the technician (if the window still shows a Reassign button, click it).) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
    • About 20 work orders with Lead Technician = [Tech-A].
  6. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Board View: you must scroll right to reach the last technician and [Tech-A]'s column is taller than the window; Tech View: the table is taller than the window. If not, add more technicians or work orders before starting.
